palette.notes: Compilation clip; two scenes carry his signature. Limited, mood-led palettes: one scene near-monochrome acid green, one crimson sky with a pale moon; others deep blue nights with orange windows.

lighting: One dominant mood colour per scene and a single strong light: moon, campfire or lit windows; rim light on silhouettes against the bright source.
silhouette: Strong dark silhouettes against a bright moon or sky (three figures on a cliff path); a seated figure on a bench under signs in the green city scene.

motion.timing: Each scene is a short loop shown for roughly 3 s in the compilation; motion is small (flames, water shimmer, flicker). Not measured.

texture: Visible dithering and noise in skies, foliage and water; chunky clusters.
camera: Locked frames, landscape format; compositions centre one focal shape (moon, train, campfire).

acting.enters: Characters are already in place when the loop starts.
acting.acts: A seated figure waits at a bus stop; three figures stand silhouetted before a moon.
acting.depth: Small figures dwarfed by the set (cliffs, moon, city) to sell mood and scale.

techniques: one mood colour per scene (green, crimson, blue)
small figures in big sets for scale
short ambient loop on a locked frame
feel: one mood colour + silhouette against the moon + small loop = moody, cinematic still
for_fred: For a quiet beat, shrink Fred to a small silhouette against a bright moon or window in the background, hold it, then cut back to him close in front. Pick one mood colour per scene.
